def clean(self): if self.id: if CustomUser.objects.filter(email=self.email.lower()).exclude(id=self.id).exists(): raise ValidationError('User with provided email already exists!') else: if CustomUser.objects.filter(email=self.email.lower()).exists(): raise ValidationError('User with provided email already exists!') self.email.lower()
def save(self, *args, **kwargs): #self.clean() return super(CustomUser, self).save(*args, **kwargs)
def __unicode__(self): return "[%05d] %s (%s)" % (self.id, self.username, self.email)

@property def shorter_format_name(self): if self.first_name: return u'{0}{1}'.format(self.first_name[:2], self.last_name) return self.last_name or "[ no name ]"
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def format_name(self, request_user=None): if self.is_superuser and request_user and not request_user.is_superuser: return _(u'SuperAdministrator') if self.last_name and self.first_name: return "%s %s" % (self.first_name, self.last_name) elif self.last_name: return self.last_name elif self.first_name: return self.first_name else: return "[ no name ]"
def format_name_and_email(self, request_user=None): if self.is_superuser and request_user and not request_user.is_superuser: return _(u'SuperAdministrator') if self.last_name and self.first_name: return u"{} {} ({})".format(self.first_name, self.last_name, self.email) elif self.last_name: return u"{} ({})".format(self.last_name, self.email) elif self.first_name: return u"{} ({})".format(self.first_name, self.email) else: return u"({})".format(self.email)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def format_role_name(self): return self.user_role.name # return const.UserRoleData[self.role]["str"]
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def is_in_group(self, group): from django.contrib.auth.models import Group
if isinstance(group, basestring): q = Q(name__iexact=group) elif isinstance(group, list): q = Q() for g in group: q |= Q(name__iexact=g) elif isinstance(group, Group): q = Q(id=group.id) else: return False
return self.groups.filter(q).count() != 0
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def has_role(self, roles): if isinstance(roles, list): return self.is_superuser or self.role in roles else: return self.is_superuser or self.role == roles
def has_role_name(self, roles): return self.is_superuser or self.user_role.name in roles
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def can_access_multicompany(self): if self.is_superuser: return True if self.is_distributor_or_multicompany_manager(): return True if self.is_superadmin_support(): return True
return False
def is_multicompany_manager(self): if self.user_role.name.lower() in [Role.MULTICOMPANY_MANAGER.value['name'].lower(), Role.SUPER_ADMIN_SUPPORT.value['name'].lower()]: return True return False
def is_superadmin_support(self): if self.user_role.name.lower() == Role.SUPER_ADMIN_SUPPORT.value['name'].lower(): return True return False
def is_super_distributor(self): if self.user_role.name.lower() == Role.SUPER_DISTRIBUTOR.value['name'].lower(): return True return False
def can_access_diagnostics(self): if self.is_superuser or self.user_role.name.lower() == Role.SUPER_DISTRIBUTOR.value['name'].lower(): return True return False
def can_access(self, permission): """ :param permission: requested user permission :return: value of requested user permission(Boolean) """ if self.is_superuser: return True
if self.user_role.televend_cloud_application is False: return False
return getattr(self.user_role, permission, False)
def has_bigger_role(self, required_role): role_list = [s.upper() for s in t3const_UserRoleList]
if required_role.upper() not in role_list: return False
return (role_list.index(self.user_role.name.upper()) > role_list.index(required_role.upper()) )
def can_induce_cash_collection(self): return self.user_role.cash_flow_induce
def can_push_tvd_configuration(self, company=None): """Defines if this user can push televend configuration. Company added as optional argument because of multi company users, primarily SuperDistributor. Need to check for which company the request is made to make sure said company allows users to push configuration. """ if not company: if not self.company: return False else: company = self.company
push_tvd_configuration = company.access.push_tvd_configuration machine_device_edit = self.user_role.machine_device_edit if push_tvd_configuration and machine_device_edit: return True
return False
def can_update_firmware(self, company): """Defines if this user is allowed to update firmware.""" if not company: return False
update_firmware = company.access.update_firmware machine_device_edit = self.user_role.machine_device_edit if update_firmware and machine_device_edit: return True
return False
def can_read_eva_dts(self, company, machine_id): """Returns True if the user is allowed to read Eva-Dts.""" if not company or not machine_id: return False
read_eva_dts = company.access.read_eva_dts machine_device_edit = self.user_role.machine_device_edit machine = Machine.objects.get(id=machine_id) eva_dts_mode = None if machine.televend_vmc_config: eva_dts_mode = machine.televend_vmc_config.eva_dts_mode
if read_eva_dts and machine_device_edit and eva_dts_mode: return True
return False
def can_perform_fiscal_certification(self): return self.user_role.fiscal_certification
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def create_password_reset_code(self): return hashlib.sha1("pwd_reset %d" % (self.id)).hexdigest()[:50]
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_link(self): # to be implemented pass
def is_distributor(self): if self.user_role.name in UserRoleDistributorList: return True else: return False
def is_super_distributor(self): return self.user_role.name == Role.SUPER_DISTRIBUTOR.value['name']
def is_company_manager(self): return self.user_role.name == Role.COMPANY_MANAGER.value['name']
def is_distributor_or_multicompany_manager(self): if self.user_role.name in ( UserRoleDistributorList + [Role.MULTICOMPANY_MANAGER.value['name']] ): return True else: return False
def delete(self): query = "DELETE FROM machineclusters_fillers WHERE customuser_id = %s" cursor = connection.cursor() cursor.execute(query, [self.id]) super(self.__class__, self).delete()
def restricted_data_access(self): if self.is_superuser: return False if self.assignment_type != AssignmentType.SHOW_ALL: return True return False
def restricted_route_access(self): """ :return: Restricted user access on routes. Return False if access is not restricted, otherwise return True """ if self.is_superuser: return False if self.user_role.route_view and not self.user_role.route_view_assigned: return False elif self.user_role.route_view_assigned: return True return True
def get_user_timezone(self): import pytz try: tz = pytz.timezone(self.timezone) except Exception as e: tz = pytz.timezone("Europe/Zagreb") finally: return tz
def user_has_importer_by_default(self, importer, view=False, manual=False): # Importer can be accessed by default by MuliCompanyManager and user type first_allowed_role = 'MulticompanyManager'.upper() role_list = [r.upper() for r in t3const_UserRoleList] first_allowed_role_index = role_list.index(first_allowed_role) user_role_index = role_list.index(self.user_role.name.upper())
if user_role_index > first_allowed_role_index: return True if user_role_index == first_allowed_role_index: if importer: if manual and importer.manual_import: return True # if company has ftp or manual import enabled, enable history view if view and (importer.active or importer.manual_import): return True
return False
def can_access_importer_base(self, company, view=False, manual=False): importer = VendingCompanyImporter.objects.filter(vending_company=company).first()
if self.is_superuser: return True, importer
if self.user_has_importer_by_default(importer, view, manual): return True, importer if not self.user_role.importer: return False, importer
if not importer or (not importer.active and not importer.manual_import): return False, importer return True, importer
def can_access_importer_view(self, company): access, importer = self.can_access_importer_base(company, view=True) if not importer: return False if access and ( self.user_has_importer_by_default(importer, view=True) or self.user_role.importer_view ): return True
if self.user_role.importer_view: return importer.active or importer.manual_import
return False
def can_access_manual_import(self, company): access, importer = self.can_access_importer_base(company, manual=True) if not importer: return False if access \ and self.user_has_importer_by_default(importer, manual=True) \ and self.user_role.name != Role.SUPER_ADMIN_SUPPORT.value['name']: return True
if access \ and self.user_has_importer_by_default(importer, manual=True) \ and self.user_role.name == Role.SUPER_ADMIN_SUPPORT.value['name']: if self.user_role.importer_edit or self.user_role.importer_view: return True
if self.user_role.importer_edit: return importer.manual_import
return False

if self.access.real_time_stock: return RoutingType.CLOUD_REAL_TIME_STOCK
if self.access.live_routing: return RoutingType.MOBILE_REAL_TIME_STOCK
if self.route_microservice: if self.access.new_route_prekitting: return RoutingType.CLOUD_PREKITTING elif self.access.new_route_real_time_stock: return RoutingType.MOBILE_REAL_TIME_STOCK
return RoutingType.NO_ROUTING

return BasicRoutingType.NO_ROUTING

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- def time_since_opened(self): now = get_current_datetime_utc() if self.weekday_mask[now.weekday()] != '1': return None now = now.time() opened = self.working_time.filter(start_time__lte=now, end_time__gte=now) if opened: start_time = opened[0].start_time diff_hour = now.hour - start_time.hour diff_min = now.minute - start_time.minute if diff_min < 0: diff_hour -= 1 diff_min += 60 difference = timedelta(minutes=diff_min, hours=diff_hour) return difference return None

def is_open(self, time): if self.weekday_mask[time.weekday()] != '1': return False
hours = time.time() if not self.working_time.filter(start_time__lte=hours, end_time__gte=hours).exists(): return False return True

for machine in machines:
events_resolved = 0 event_data = []
above_tolerated_general = is_above_tolerated_no_sales( machine=machine, alarm_type=SalesAlarmType.GENERAL, vend_time_field='last_vend_timestamp', sales_window_field='no_sales_window_any', ) if not above_tolerated_general: event_data += ['any_nosales', 'nosales']

above_tolerated_cashless_2 = is_above_tolerated_no_sales( alarm_type=SalesAlarmType.CASHLESS_2, machine=machine, vend_time_field='last_cashless_2_vend_timestamp', sales_window_field='no_sales_window_cashless_2', ) if not above_tolerated_cashless_2: event_data += ['cashless_2_nosales', 'nosales']
above_tolerated_cashless_3 = is_above_tolerated_no_sales( alarm_type=SalesAlarmType.CASHLESS_3, machine=machine, vend_time_field='last_cashless_3_vend_timestamp', sales_window_field='no_sales_window_cashless_3', )
if not not above_tolerated_cashless_3: event_data += ['cashless_3_nosales', 'nosales'] if event_data: events_resolved = EventDatabaseHandler.resolve_for_list_of_data( machine_id=machine.id, event_data_list=set(event_data) ) if events_resolved: machine.status.save()

def __unicode__(self): return "[{id}] Device type: {device_type}, pid: {pid}".format( id=self.id, device_type=self.device_type, pid=self.pid, )
@transaction.atomic def activate(self): """ Activate self. Deactivate other devices connected to assigned machine. """ self.kill_alive_devices_of_the_same_type() if self.active: return
activated_at = timezone.now()
machines = self.machines.all() if len(machines) == 1: self.active = True self.save() record = DeviceHistory.objects.create( activated_at=activated_at, device=self, machine=machines[0] ) machine = machines[0] ( Event .objects .filter(machine_id=machine.id, level__gt=1, resolved_time__isnull=True) .update(resolved_time=timezone.now()) ) machine.status.save()
Device.bulk_deactivate( filter_kw={'machines': machine.id}, exclude_kw={'id': self.id}, deactivated_at=activated_at )
def deactivate(self): """ Deactivate self. """ if not self.active: return
self.active = False self.save()
last_record = DeviceHistory.objects.filter( device=self, deactivated_at__isnull=True ).order_by('id').last()
if last_record: last_record.deactivated_at = timezone.now() last_record.save()
@staticmethod def bulk_deactivate(filter_kw, exclude_kw=None, deactivated_at=None): """ Update history and deactivate devices. """ if not deactivated_at: deactivated_at = timezone.now()
devices = Device.objects.filter(**filter_kw) if exclude_kw: devices = devices.exclude(**exclude_kw) devices.update(active=False)
newest_records = DeviceHistory.objects.filter(device__in=devices) newest_records = newest_records.values('machine', 'device').annotate(Max('id')) newest_records = newest_records.values_list('id__max', flat=True)
DeviceHistory.objects.filter( id__in=newest_records, deactivated_at__isnull=True ).update(deactivated_at=deactivated_at)
def kill_alive_devices_of_the_same_type(self): machines = self.machines.all() if len(machines) == 1: machine = machines[0]
updated_devices = Device.objects.filter( machines=machine.id, device_type=self.device_type, ).exclude(id=self.id).update(alive=False, active=False) if updated_devices: device_log.warning( "Device with id={0} and type {1} caused {2} devices of the same type to be deleted.".format( self.id, self.device_type.type, updated_devices ) )

def was_active_then(self, machine, then, rigorous=False): """ Check if device was active in given period on given machine. :param machine: class `~Machine` :param then: timezone aware datetime :return: bool """ records = DeviceHistory.objects.filter(machine=machine)
if records.filter(activated_at__lte=then, deactivated_at__gt=then, device=self).exists(): return True elif rigorous: return False
devices_activated_later = records.exclude(device=self).values('device', 'machine') devices_activated_later = devices_activated_later.annotate(Min('activated_at')) devices_activated_later = devices_activated_later.filter(activated_at__min__gt=then)
if devices_activated_later.count() == machine.devices.exclude(id=self.id).count(): return True
return False
@receiver(m2m_changed, sender=Device.machines.through) def one_machine_per_device(**kwargs): """ Prevent adding more than one machine to device. :param kwargs: action, instance and set containing machines' ids. :return: None """ action = kwargs.get('action', None) instance = kwargs.get('instance', None) pk_set = kwargs.get('pk_set', None)
if action == "pre_add": if instance.machines.count(): raise ValidationError('Device has already been assigned')
machines = Machine.objects.filter(id__in=pk_set) if len(machines) > 1: raise ValidationError('Device cannot be added to more ' 'than one machine')
machine = machines[0] if machines else None if machine and machine.owner_id != instance.owner_id: raise ValidationError('Machine and device have different owners')

def as_dict(self): """ Return information about televend as dictionary. """ return { 'SIM': self.sim or '-', 'last_message_type': self.last_message_type or u'None', 'last_message_timestamp': format_datetime( self.last_message_timestamp ), 'last_audit_time': format_datetime(self.last_D_AUDIT_timestamp), 'last_assign_message': format_datetime( self.last_R_M_ASSIGN_timestamp ), 'machine_ip': self._resolve_televend_ip(), 'last_init': format_datetime(self.last_init_time), 'reason': self.get_last_R_M_ASSIGN_reason_display(), 'last_sw_info': self.get_fw_info() }
def get_fw_info(self): """ Find last D_FIRMWARE command and user who sent it. """
firmware_message = MachineCommand.objects.filter( machine=self.machine, sent__isnull=False ).filter(Q(command='D_FIRMWARE') | Q(command='D_FIRMWARE_I')).order_by('-sent')
# check if televend device firmware was updated by the bulk action # get the date and user who made the bulk action bulk_info = BulkCommandProcessItem.objects.filter(machine_id=self.machine.id).aggregate(Max('last_status_change')) bulk_info = bulk_info['last_status_change__max']
if bulk_info is not None: date_bulk_row = BulkCommandProcessItem.objects.filter(machine_id=self.machine.id, last_status_change=bulk_info) bulk_row_user = date_bulk_row[0].parent_process.triggered_by
if firmware_message.exists(): fw_m = firmware_message[0] fw_user = '' if bulk_info is not None and bulk_info > fw_m.sent: bulk_fw_user = _(u' by ') + bulk_row_user.format_name() return format_datetime(bulk_info) + bulk_fw_user else: if fw_m.user: fw_user = _(u' by ') + fw_m.user.format_name() return format_datetime(fw_m.sent) + fw_user elif bulk_info is not None: bulk_fw_user = _(u' by ') + bulk_row_user.format_name() return format_datetime(bulk_info) + bulk_fw_user else: return '-'
def get_firmware_version_as_list(self, limit=3): if self.firmware_version: _fw_list = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'(\d+)', self.firmware_version)] if limit is not None: _fw_list = _fw_list[:limit] return _fw_list return []
def get_firmware_version_display(self, limit=3): return ".".join([str(x) for x in self.get_firmware_version_as_list(limit)])
def _resolve_televend_ip(self): televend_ip = self.last_televend_ip or self.last_ip if self.machine.use_dm and self.last_televend_ip == self.last_ip: televend_ip = '-' return televend_ip

def validate_data(self, data): data_validator = Validator(ds_schema) is_valid = data_validator.validate(data) return is_valid, data_validator.errors
def insert_device_status(self, data): if not data.get('device_id'): try: pid = data.get('pid') device_log.info('Searching for device with provided pid {}'.format(pid)) device = TelevendDevice.objects.get(pid=pid) data['device_id'] = device.id data['machine_id'] = device.machine.id except ObjectDoesNotExist: device_log.error('Device with provided pid {} does not exist or is not a Televend device'.format(pid)) raise ObjectDoesNotExist('Device with provided pid {} does not exist or is not a Televend device'.format(pid))
validation = self.validate_data(data) # check if validation returns True, then proceed to create new instance of DeviceStatus. if validation[0]: instance = self.create(device_id=data['device_id'], machine_id=data['machine_id'], timestamp=data['timestamp'], voltage_battery=data['voltage_battery'], voltage_min=data['voltage_min'], voltage_max=data['voltage_max'], internal_temperature_min=data['internal_temperature_min'], internal_temperature_max=data['internal_temperature_max'], fuse=data['fuse'], external_temperature_min=data.get('external_temperature_min', None), external_temperature_max=data.get('external_temperature_max', None) ) return instance else: device_log.error('Errors encountered during processing: {}'.format(str(validation[1]))) return validation[1]

objects = DeviceStatusManager()
@classmethod def insert_device_status_data(cls, data): """ :param data: dictionary containing diagnostic data with keys named identically to model field names. :type data: dict :return: Instance of DeviceStatus :rtype: DeviceStatus """ return cls.objects.insert_device_status(data=data)
@classmethod def get_device_status_data(cls, device_id, data_type, timestamp, period): """ :param device_id: ID of the device for which data is requested(integer) :param data_type: voltage or temperature(str) :param timestamp: reference timestamp from which to return data(datetime) :param period: period in the past for which to return data(1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, 2 months in days)(int) :return: date and requested data type data(dict) """ period = int(period) date_from = timestamp date_to = timestamp - timedelta(period)
data_set = cls.objects.filter(device_id=device_id, timestamp__lte=date_from, timestamp__gte=date_to)
data = cls.transform_device_status_data(data_set=data_set, data_type=data_type) date_data = data.keys() or [] requested_data = data.values() or []
return {'date_series': date_data, data_type: requested_data}
@classmethod def transform_device_status_data(cls, data_set, data_type): """ :param data_set: data set received from get_device_status_data method :param data_type: voltage or temperature :return: dataset transformed from timestamp to date division, with peak values for each date """ data = OrderedDict() max_property = data_type + '_max' min_property = data_type + '_min' data_set = (data_set. annotate(date=TruncDate('timestamp')))
dates = data_set.distinct('date').values_list('date', flat=True) for date in dates: max_data = data_set.filter(date=date).aggregate(Max(max_property)) min_data = data_set.filter(date=date).aggregate(Min(min_property)) data.update({str(date): {max_property: max_data[max_property+"__max"], min_property: min_data[min_property+"__min"]}
})
return data

class BaseMachineUrgency(BaseUrgency): # Has to inherit models.Model not SoftDeletionModel, because routes do not use SofDeletionModel urgency_reason = models.CharField(max_length=8, blank=True) daily_urgency_reasons = ArrayField( models.CharField(max_length=8, editable=False), default=[], editable=False ) URGENCY_REASONS = { 'r': 'REFILL', 'e': 'EXPIRE', 'f': 'FACING', 's': 'SCHEDULE', 'l': 'LOCATION', }
class Meta: abstract = True
def get_urgency_reason(self, daily_urgency=None): if daily_urgency is None: urgency_reason = self.urgency_reason else: if len(self.daily_urgency_reasons) > daily_urgency: urgency_reason = self.daily_urgency_reasons[daily_urgency] else: urgency_reason = ''
return (urgency_reason or '').lower()
def full_reasons(self, short=False, daily_urgency=None): reason = self.get_urgency_reason(daily_urgency=daily_urgency) if short: reason = reason[:2] return [self.URGENCY_REASONS[r] for r in reason]
def urgency_reason_key_format(self, short=False, daily_urgency=None): reason = self.get_urgency_reason(daily_urgency=daily_urgency) if short: reason = reason[:2] return reason.upper()
def urgency_reason_full_format(self, short=False, daily_urgency=None): reasons = self.full_reasons(short=short, daily_urgency=daily_urgency) return ' + '.join(reasons)
def urgency_reason_format(self, short=False, key=False, full=False, daily_urgency=None): """ :param short: Defines number of reasons shown (2 if short else all) :param key: Defines formatting as key formatting(Only first capital letters are shown, without delimiter) :param full: Defines formatting as full formatting (Whole words with capital letters are shown with ' + ' as delimiter) :param daily_urgency: None for current urgency, list index for daily_urgency """ if key: return self.urgency_reason_key_format(short=short, daily_urgency=daily_urgency) elif full: return self.urgency_reason_full_format(short=short, daily_urgency=daily_urgency)

def resolve_external_modification_info(self, external_author): """ Args: external_author(str): External author name, given as string Returns: Modified time string concatenated with external_author value """ if type(external_author) not in (str, unicode): try: external_author = str(external_author) except (TypeError, ValueError) as e: external_author = _("Unknown") modified_info = self.get_modified_time() + _(u" by ") + external_author return modified_info
def resolve_external_creation_info(self, external_author): """ Args: external_author(str): External author name, given as string Returns: Created time concatenated with external_author value, unless created_by exists in associated author_info """ if type(external_author) not in (str, unicode): try: external_author = str(external_author) except (TypeError, ValueError) as e: external_author = _("Unknown") if self.author_info and self.author_info.date_created and not self.author_info.created_by: created_info = self.get_created_time(time_format="%d.%m.%Y %H:%M") + _(u" by ") + external_author elif self.author_info and self.author_info.created_by: created_info = self.get_created_info() else: created_info = _(u'Unknown')
return created_info

def return_next_filling_date(self, urgency_data): tz = self.owner.timezone now_date = datetime_localize(timezone.now(), tz).date() since_refill = 0 if self.status.last_refill_timestamp: last_refill = datetime_localize( self.status.last_refill_timestamp, tz ) last_refill = last_refill.date() since_refill = (now_date - last_refill).days
try: days_to_exceed_limit = urgency_data[self.id]['days_to_exceed_limit'] except KeyError: days_to_exceed_limit = 21 except TypeError: days_to_exceed_limit = 21
earliest_expiry_in_days = ( (since_refill + days_to_exceed_limit) or settings.EARLIEST_EXPIRY_IN_DAYS_DEFAULT )
next_filling_date = now_date + timedelta(days=earliest_expiry_in_days) return next_filling_date

def set_erp_config(self, next_erp_type): """ :param erp_state: next_erp_type ErpIntegrationType.OFF, ErpIntegrationType.EVA_FROM_HISTORY, ErpIntegrationType.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING, ErpIntegrationType.NO_EVA :return: None """ if not self.owner.uses_erp: return
# (old_erp_type, new_erp_type): (send_eva_to_erp, send_lto_to_erp) T = ErpIntegrationType mapping = { (T.OFF, T.EVA_FROM_HISTORY): (False, False), (T.OFF, T.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING): (False, False), (T.OFF, T.NO_EVA): (False, True),
(T.EVA_FROM_HISTORY, T.OFF): (False, False), (T.EVA_FROM_HISTORY, T.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING): (False, True), (T.EVA_FROM_HISTORY, T.NO_EVA): (False, True),
(T.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING, T.OFF): (False, False), (T.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING, T.EVA_FROM_HISTORY): (False, False), (T.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING, T.NO_EVA): (False, True),
(T.NO_EVA, T.OFF): (False, False), (T.NO_EVA, T.EVA_FROM_HISTORY): (False, False), (T.NO_EVA, T.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING): (False, True), }
current_erp_type = self.get_erp_integration_type() self.send_eva_to_erp, self.send_lto_to_erp = mapping.get( (current_erp_type, next_erp_type), (self.send_eva_to_erp, self.send_lto_to_erp) ) self.erp_integration_type = next_erp_type.value
def activate_erp_integration_on_televend_cash_collection(self): if self.get_erp_integration_type() is not ErpIntegrationType.EVA_FROM_BEGINNING: return
if self.send_eva_to_erp: return
self.send_eva_to_erp = True self.send_lto_to_erp = True self.save(update_fields=["send_eva_to_erp", "send_lto_to_erp"])
def activate_erp_integration_on_hendheld_cash_collection(self): if self.get_erp_integration_type() is not ErpIntegrationType.EVA_FROM_HISTORY: return
if self.send_eva_to_erp: return
self.send_eva_to_erp = True self.send_lto_to_erp = True self.save()
@property def external_id_ascii_percent(self): """ Converts external_id to string containing only ASCII characters that are not reserverd characters in percent encoding. If such character exists, it is converted to "." If external_id is empty string UNDEF is returned.
!!!IMPORTANT!!! Used only as first parameter of D_ASSIGN_M message data!
:returns: Converted external_id string :rtype: string """
DELIMITER = '_' PROHIBITTED_CHARS = list(PERCENT_ENCODING_CHARS) + list(DELIMITER)
def is_ascii(c): return ord(c) < 128
external_id = '' for character in self.external_id: if is_ascii(character) and character not in PROHIBITTED_CHARS: external_id += character else: external_id += '.'
return external_id or 'UNDEF'

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- @property def device(self): """ Active Device assigned to machine, if exists :return: Device """ if not hasattr(self, '_device'): if hasattr(self, '_prefetched_active_device'): devices = self._prefetched_active_device elif hasattr(self, 'active_devices'): devices = self.active_devices else: devices = self.devices.filter(active=True) active_devices_count = len(devices) if active_devices_count > 1: device_log.error( "Machine {} has {} active devices!".format( self.id, active_devices_count ) ) if active_devices_count == 1: self._device = devices[0] else: self._device = None
return self._device

@property def televend(self): """ Active TelevendDevice assigned to machine, if exist. _televenddevice is used by dataserver. @classmethod def get_category_stocks_all(self, owner_id, machine_list): cursor = connection.cursor()
query = "select avg(cast(mc.current_quantity as float) / cast(mc.next_fill_quantity as float)) as percentage," \ " mc.machine_id, pc.caption from machine_columns as mc join products as p on p.id = mc.product_id " \ "join product_categories as pc on pc.id = p.category_id " \ "join machines as m on mc.machine_id = m.id where mc.pushed = true and m.owner_id = {0} " \ "and m.alive = true and m.enabled = true and mc.next_fill_quantity > 0 " \ "group by pc.caption, mc.machine_id order by mc.machine_id, pc.caption;" \ .format(owner_id)
cursor.execute(query) desc = cursor.description
data = dict()
for row in cursor.fetchall(): if data.has_key(row[1]): data[row[1]].append({'percentage': row[0], 'category': row[2]}) else: data[row[1]] = [{'percentage': row[0], 'category': row[2]}]
for machine in machine_list: machine.category_stocks = "
".join(u"{}: {:.2%}" .format(m['category'], m['percentage']) for m in data[machine.id])
return machine_list
def get_category_stocks(self): query = u""" select avg(cast(mc.current_quantity as float) / cast(mc.next_fill_quantity as float)) as percentage, pc.caption from machine_columns as mc join products as p on p.id = mc.product_id join product_categories as pc on pc.id = p.category_id where mc.pushed = true and mc.machine_id = {} and mc.next_fill_quantity > 0 group by pc.caption order by pc.caption; """.format(self.id) cursor = connection.cursor() cursor.execute(query)
return [{'percentage': row[0], 'category': row[1]} for row in cursor.fetchall()]
def get_category_stocks_html(self): category_stocks = ( self.get_stock_data().get('category_percentages') or self.get_category_stocks() ) line = u"{}: {:.2%}" return "
".join(line.format(m['category'], m['percentage']) for m in category_stocks)
def fetch_stock_data(self): def sum_of_percentages(elements): sum_of_percentages = 0. for element in elements: current_quantity = element.current_quantity max_quantity = max(element.next_fill_quantity, 0) or element.max_quantity if current_quantity > max_quantity: sum_of_percentages += 1. else: sum_of_percentages += ( float(current_quantity) / float(max_quantity) if max_quantity else 0.) return sum_of_percentages
q = Q(machine_id=self.id, max_quantity__gt=0, pushed=True) product_q = Q(product__is_composite=False, product__blacklisted=False) component_q = Q(component__stock=True, component__blacklisted=False) columns = ( self.columns if hasattr(self, 'columns') else MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(q, product_q) ) components = ( self.components if hasattr(self, 'components') else MachineProductComponent.all_objects.filter(q, component_q) )
p_sum = sum_of_percentages(columns) c_sum = sum_of_percentages(components) p_num = len(columns) c_num = len(components)
negative_value_query = Q(machine_id=self.id, current_quantity__lt=0, pushed=True) has_negative_value_product = MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(negative_value_query, product_q).exists() has_negative_value_component = MachineProductComponent.all_objects.filter( negative_value_query, component_q).exists()
try: percentage = (float(p_sum + c_sum) / float(p_num + c_num)) except ZeroDivisionError: percentage = 0.
return { 'percentage': percentage, 'sum_column_percentage': float(p_sum), 'num_column': float(p_num), 'product_percentage': float(p_sum) / float(p_num) if p_num else 0., 'sum_component_percentage': float(c_sum), 'num_component': float(c_num), 'component_percentage': float(c_sum) / float(c_num) if c_num else 0., 'category_percentages': self.get_category_stocks(), 'has_negative_value_product': has_negative_value_product, 'has_negative_value_component': has_negative_value_component }
@transaction.atomic def rebuild_stock_data(self): if self.last_stock_calculation: seconds_since_last_calculation = ( timezone.now() - self.last_stock_calculation).total_seconds() if seconds_since_last_calculation < settings.STOCK_REBUILD_TIMEOUT: return
stock_data = self.fetch_stock_data() self.stock_data = json.dumps(stock_data) self.stock = stock_data['percentage'] self.last_stock_calculation = timezone.now() self.save(update_fields=["stock_data", "stock", "last_stock_calculation"])
def get_stock_data(self): if hasattr(self, '_stock_data'): return self._stock_data
try: data = json.loads(self.stock_data) if not data: data = self.fetch_stock_data() except (TypeError, ValueError): data = self.fetch_stock_data() self._stock_data = data
return data
def format_name(self): res = []
if self.location is not None and len(self.location.caption.strip()) != 0: res.append(self.location.caption.strip())
if len(self.caption.strip()) != 0: res.append(self.caption.strip())
return " : ".join(res) if len(res) != 0 else "-"

def get_columns(self, composite=None): if self.id != 0: q = Q(machine=self, pushed=True, max_quantity__gt=0) if composite is not None: q &= Q(product__is_composite=composite) return MachineColumn.objects.filter(q).order_by("product__is_composite", "index") else: return MachineColumn.objects.none()
def get_pushed_columns(self): return MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(machine=self, pushed=True).order_by("index")
def has_composite(self): if not hasattr(self, '_has_composite'): if hasattr(self, 'machinecolumns'): self._has_composite = any( filter( lambda mc: mc.product.is_composite and mc.pushed, self.machinecolumns ) ) else: self._has_composite = MachineColumn.all_objects.filter( machine=self, product__is_composite=True, pushed=True ) self._has_composite = self._has_composite.exists() return self._has_composite
def has_noncomposite(self): if not hasattr(self, '_has_noncomposite'): if hasattr(self, 'machinecolumns'): self._has_noncomposite = any( filter( lambda mc: not mc.product.is_composite and mc.pushed, self.machinecolumns ) ) else: self._has_noncomposite = MachineColumn.all_objects.filter( machine=self, product__is_composite=False, pushed=True) self._has_noncomposite = self._has_noncomposite.exists() return self._has_noncomposite
def has_pending(self): """ produce query which checks wether we have price change or product change QUERY:
SELECT (1) AS "a" FROM "machine_columns" WHERE
"machine_columns"."machine_id" = :machine_id: AND ( ("machine_columns"."pushed" = FALSE AND "machine_columns"."alive" = TRUE) OR ("machine_columns"."pushed" = TRUE AND "machine_columns"."alive" = FALSE) OR ( "machine_columns"."pushed" = TRUE AND "machine_columns"."alive" = TRUE AND ( "machine_columns"."changed_price" IS NOT NULL OR "machine_columns"."changed_price_2" IS NOT NULL OR "machine_columns"."changed_price_3" IS NOT NULL OR "machine_columns"."changed_price_4" IS NOT NULL OR "machine_columns"."changed_price_5" IS NOT NULL ) ) ) LIMIT 1;
:return: :rtype: """ # region PRICE_HANDLING qlive = Q(alive=True, pushed=False) qlive |= Q(alive=False, pushed=True)
qprice_change = Q(changed_price__isnull=False) qprice_change |= Q(changed_price_2__isnull=False) qprice_change |= Q(changed_price_3__isnull=False) qprice_change |= Q(changed_price_4__isnull=False) qprice_change |= Q(changed_price_5__isnull=False)
qprice_change_live = Q(alive=True, pushed=True)
q = Q(machine=self) & (qlive | (qprice_change_live & qprice_change)) #endregion return MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(q).exists()
def has_pending_price_change(self): # region PRICE_HANDLING q = Q(changed_price__isnull=False) q |= Q(changed_price_2__isnull=False) q |= Q(changed_price_3__isnull=False) q |= Q(changed_price_4__isnull=False) q |= Q(changed_price_5__isnull=False) q &= Q(machine=self) #endregion return MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(q).exists()
@property def has_pending_mapping(self): """ Return whether mapping was changed on machine. :return: bool """ query = Q(changed_index=None) & Q(changed_mapped_indexes=None) return self.machinecolumn_set.exclude(query).exists()
@property def is_mapping_editable(self): """ Return whether mapping can be edited on machine. :return: bool """ return ((self.use_column_mapping or self.use_second_column_mapping) and not self.is_in_active_route() and not self.has_pending() and not self.new_route_status() )
@property def is_mapping_undoable(self): """ Return whether mapping can be edited on machine. :return: bool """ return (self.use_column_mapping and not self.is_in_active_route() and self.has_pending_mapping and not self.new_route_status() )
def is_mapping_settable(self, mapping_settings): """ Check whether mapping options can be edited on this machine. :mapping_settings: dict :return: bool """ pending_mapping = self.has_pending_mapping pending_columns = self.has_pending()
if (pending_mapping or pending_columns) and mapping_settings['mapping_option'] is not None:
if mapping_settings['mapping_option'] == 'custom': if self.offset_mapping != 0 or not self.use_column_mapping: return False if mapping_settings['mapping_option'] == 'offset': if self.offset_mapping == 0 or self.use_column_mapping: return False
use_mapping = self.use_column_mapping or self.offset_mapping != 0 if (pending_mapping or pending_columns) and mapping_settings['mapping_option'] is None and use_mapping: return False
if pending_columns and mapping_settings['mapping_option'] == 'offset': try: offset = int(mapping_settings['mapping_offset']) except (ValueError, KeyError): return True if self.offset_mapping != offset: return False
return True

def get_last_vend_date_time(self): if self.status and self.status.last_vend_timestamp: try: return self.status.last_vend_timestamp.strftime("%d.%m.%Y. %H:%M") except (ValueError, AttributeError): return "-" return "-"
def get_last_vend_time(self): vend_timestamp = self.status.last_vend_timestamp if vend_timestamp is None: return "-" else: return vend_timestamp.strftime(StrfDateTimeString)
def get_last_refill(self): timestamp = self.status.last_refill_timestamp if timestamp: return timestamp.strftime(StrfDateTimeString) else: return "-"
def get_last_valid_date(self): if not self.owner.access.valid_until: return timestamp = self.status.last_valid_date if timestamp: return timestamp.strftime(StrfDateString) else: return "-"
def get_last_correction_info(self): last_fill_log = self.filllogitem_set.select_related("user").filter( fill_type=FillType.CORRECTED.value ).order_by('-timestamp').first() if last_fill_log and last_fill_log.timestamp: info = last_fill_log.timestamp.strftime( '%d.%m.%Y. %H:%M:%S' ) if last_fill_log.user: return info, ' [{0}]'.format(last_fill_log.user.format_name())
return info, "" else: return "-", ""

def get_absolute_percentage(self): sum_of_percentages = 0. num_of_percentages = 0 for column in self.get_columns(composite=False): current_quantity = column.current_quantity max_quantity = column.next_fill_quantity or column.max_quantity if current_quantity > max_quantity: sum_of_percentages += 1 else: if not max_quantity: continue sum_of_percentages += float(current_quantity) / float(max_quantity) if max_quantity else 0. num_of_percentages += 1
for component in self.get_components(): if not component.component.stock: continue current_quantity = component.current_quantity max_quantity = component.next_fill_quantity or \ component.max_quantity if current_quantity > max_quantity: sum_of_percentages += 1 else: if not max_quantity: continue sum_of_percentages += float(current_quantity) / float(max_quantity) if max_quantity else 0. num_of_percentages += 1
try: percentage = float(sum_of_percentages / float(num_of_percentages)) if num_of_percentages else 0. except ZeroDivisionError: percentage = 0.
return percentage
def get_absolute_percentage_product(self, category=None): sum_of_percentages = 0. num_of_percentages = 0 columns = self.get_columns(composite=False) if len(columns) == 0: return 1.0 for column in columns: current_quantity = column.current_quantity relevant_quantity = column.next_fill_quantity if column.next_fill_quantity >= current_quantity else column.max_quantity if current_quantity > relevant_quantity: sum_of_percentages += 1 else: sum_of_percentages += float(current_quantity) / float(relevant_quantity) if relevant_quantity else 0.
if relevant_quantity: num_of_percentages += 1
try: percentage = float(sum_of_percentages / float(num_of_percentages)) if num_of_percentages else 0. except ZeroDivisionError: percentage = 0.
return percentage
def get_absolute_percentage_component(self): sum_of_percentages = 0. num_of_percentages = 0
for component in self.get_components(): if not component.component.stock: continue current_quantity = component.current_quantity relevant_quantity = (component.next_fill_quantity if component.next_fill_quantity >= current_quantity else component.max_quantity)
if current_quantity > relevant_quantity: sum_of_percentages += 1 else: sum_of_percentages += float(current_quantity) / float(relevant_quantity) if relevant_quantity else 0.
if relevant_quantity: num_of_percentages += 1
try: percentage = float(sum_of_percentages / float(num_of_percentages)) if num_of_percentages else 0. except ZeroDivisionError: percentage = 0.
return percentage

def is_in_active_route(self): if hasattr(self, '_is_in_active_route'): return self._is_in_active_route
active_rms = list(self.routemachineactiveview_set.all()) if active_rms: self._is_in_active_route = active_rms[0].route else: self._is_in_active_route = False
return self._is_in_active_route
def is_in_active_refill_route(self): if not self.owner.route_microservice: if hasattr(self, '_is_in_active_refill_route'): return self._is_in_active_refill_route
rms = self.routemachines.filter(removed=False, refill=True) rms = rms.prefetch_related('route') routes = [rm.route for rm in rms]
if not len(routes): self._is_in_active_refill_route = False
for route in routes: if not route.is_expired() and not route.is_completed(): if not route.routemachines.get(removed=False, refill=True, machine=self).served_time: self._is_in_active_refill_route = route break else: self._is_in_active_refill_route = False
return self._is_in_active_refill_route
return self.new_route_active
def is_in_active_route_specific(self, route_type=RouteType.REFILL): from route.models import RouteMachine, RouteMachineActiveView
if route_type is RouteType.REFILL: q_rm = Q(refill=True) elif route_type is RouteType.CASH_COLLECTION: q_rm = Q(collect_cash=True) else: return False
try: route_machine_view = RouteMachineActiveView.objects.get(q_rm, machine_id=self.id, ) return RouteMachine.objects.get(id=route_machine_view.id) except (RouteMachineActiveView.DoesNotExist, RouteMachineActiveView.MultipleObjectsReturned): return False
def get_new_route_details(self, task, allow_future_routes=FutureRoutesEnum.FORBIDDEN.value, specific_route_help_id=None): """ Fetch route data from Routes service. Args: task: either 1 or 2, as defined in IButtonType enum. allow_future_routes: either 0 or 1 as defined in FutureRoutesEnum - default value is 0 for backwards compatibility - set to 1 if you want to fetch data for routes in the future Added because new requirement for cash collection must allow finishing cash collection task for routes in the future if route for today is not present. specific_route_help_id: ID of the route to get details for. Needed because now bluetooth refill/cash collection can be done for any route and not only for today's route. """ try: url = "{}/v2/mobile/find_machine_in_route/{}/{}/{}".format(settings.ROUTE_DOMAIN_API, self.owner.id, self.id, task) params = {"future_routes": allow_future_routes} if specific_route_help_id: params.update({"route_help_id": specific_route_help_id}) request = requests.get( url, params=params, timeout=RequestTimeoutInSeconds.MEDIUM.value) logger_new_route.info(">>> MACHINE STATUS CODE: {} {} {}".format(url, request.status_code, request.json())) return request.json() except Exception: logger_new_route.exception(">>> PROBLEMS ON SENDING TASK TO NEW ROUTE.") return {"status": None, "data": None}
def process_button_type_no_routes(self, button_type): try: button_type = IButtonType(int(button_type)) except (TypeError, ValueError): return False
if button_type == IButtonType.REFILL: return "2_1" elif button_type == IButtonType.CASH_COLLECTION: return "1_1"
return False
def handle_route_task(self, machine_new_route, button_type): if not self.new_route_active or not machine_new_route['status']: return False
route_id = machine_new_route['data']['route_id'] route_filler = machine_new_route['data']['filler'] route_type_routes = int(machine_new_route['data']['route_type']) try: user = CustomUser.objects.get(id=route_filler) except CustomUser.DoesNotExist: user = None if user: self.status.last_price_user = user
redis = get_redis_cache() if route_type_routes == RouteType.REFILL.value and int(button_type) == IButtonType.REFILL.value: redis_key = 'mobile.custom.route.refill.{}'.format(self.id) redis.set(redis_key, machine_new_route['data'], settings.REFILL_TASK_REDIS_DURATION) elif route_type_routes == RouteType.CASH_COLLECTION.value and int(button_type) == IButtonType.CASH_COLLECTION.value: redis_key = 'mobile.custom.route.cash.{}'.format(self.id) redis.set(redis_key, machine_new_route['data'], settings.CASH_COLLECTION_TASK_REDIS_DURATION) elif route_type_routes == RouteType.REFILL_AND_CASH_COLLECTION.value: redis_key_refill = 'mobile.custom.route.refill.{}'.format(self.id) redis_key_cash = 'mobile.custom.route.cash.{}'.format(self.id) redis.set(redis_key_refill, machine_new_route['data'], settings.REFILL_TASK_REDIS_DURATION) redis.set(redis_key_cash, machine_new_route['data'], settings.CASH_COLLECTION_TASK_REDIS_DURATION) else: return False
try: map_on = self.has_pending() or self.has_pending_mapping if map_on: map_on = is_machine_in_active_route_with_planogram_change_task( machine_id=self.id, company_id=self.owner_id, default_value_if_routes_offline=True, route_id=route_id ) if not map_on: send_request_to_route_for_finish_task.apply_async( (route_id, self.id, route_filler, route_type_routes), countdown=5 ) except Exception: logger_new_route.exception("PROBLEMS ON REQUEST API.")
answer_key_map = { RouteType.REFILL.value: "2_1", RouteType.CASH_COLLECTION.value: "1_1", RouteType.REFILL_AND_CASH_COLLECTION.value: "1,2_1" } answer_key = answer_key_map.get(route_type_routes)
logger_new_route.info( 'BUTTON TYPE: {} NEW ROUTE TASK: {} COMMAND: {}'.format(button_type, route_type_routes, answer_key) ) return answer_key def get_response_to_i_button(self, button_type, route_type=None): logger_new_route.info(">>> SENDING I_BUTTON TO TELEVEND. TYPE OF ROUTE: {}".format(route_type)) new_route = self.owner.route_microservice
time_limit = timezone.now() - timedelta(minutes=settings.INDUCTION_LIMIT) induction = CashCollectionInduction.objects.filter( machine=self, started_at__gt=time_limit ).exclude(status=InductionStatus.COLLECTED.value)
if induction.exists(): return False
# Get machine route details if `new_route` is enabled machine_new_route = None if new_route: machine_new_route = self.get_new_route_details(button_type)
# Check if we should handle this as no-route behavior enable_i_button_when_route_enabled = self.owner.access.enable_i_button_when_route_enabled if not new_route or ( new_route and enable_i_button_when_route_enabled and (not self.new_route_active or not machine_new_route['status']) ): return self.process_button_type_no_routes(button_type)
if route_type: return route_type
logger_new_route.info(">>> This is collection from Televend only on manually request.") logger_new_route.info(">>> RESPONSE FROM ROUTES: {}".format(machine_new_route)) # Handle route-specific tasks return self.handle_route_task(machine_new_route, button_type)
def get_sales_revenue_for_month(self): last_month_date = timezone.now().date() - timedelta(days=30) try: sum_value = ( VendReport.objects.using("readonly") .values("value") .filter(machine_id=self.id, date__gte=last_month_date) .aggregate(sum=Sum("value")) )["sum"] if sum_value is None: return 0.0 else: return sum_value except: return 0.0
def get_televend_config_string(self): """ Get televend configuration as string where options are separated by _. """ televend_vmc_config = self.televend_vmc_config
if televend_vmc_config is None: device_log.warning( "Machine {} does not have Televend Configuration saved! Default configuration string will be used!!!".format(self.id) ) return ''
# obsolete field, we send 'FFFF' to assure back compatibility with old firmwares televend_vmc_config.enable_manual_dispense = 'FFFF'
options_for_config_string = [] for option in main_const.TelevendOptions: if option in main_const.TelevendOptionsIgnore: continue
# These options are Boolean values, which need to be converted to 0 or 1 prior to being appended to # configuration string. if option in ('enable_escrow', 'electronic_tray_label', 'apn_2'): options_for_config_string.append(str(int( getattr(televend_vmc_config, option) or False )))
elif option == 'keep_alive_address': options_for_config_string.append(getattr(televend_vmc_config, option) or 'OFF')
# The temperature_sensor_setting attribute will be sent through to the Televend enlarged by a # constant to ensure that a positive integer value is always sent. elif option == 'temperature_sensor_setting': options_for_config_string.append(str(getattr(televend_vmc_config, option) + main_const.TELEVEND_TEMPERATURE_SENSOR_CONSTANT)) elif option == 'tenant_id': options_for_config_string.append(str(settings.TELEVEND_DOMAIN_ID))
elif option == 'country_code': options_for_config_string.append(str(self.country_code_iso_3166_numeric))
elif main_const.TelevendOptionsPricelist.get(option): pricelist_options = main_const.TelevendOptionsPricelist.get(option) pricelist_option_array = [] for pricelist_option in pricelist_options: if getattr(televend_vmc_config, pricelist_option): pricelist_option_array.append(str(int(getattr(televend_vmc_config, pricelist_option)))) pricelist_option_array.append(str(getattr(televend_vmc_config, option)))
options_for_config_string.append(''.join(pricelist_option_array))
# Unimplemented options which have to be sent in the configuration string elif main_const.TelevendOptionsPlaceholder.get(option): options_for_config_string.append(main_const.TelevendOptionsPlaceholder[option])
elif option in main_const.TelevendMachineOptions: options_for_config_string.append(str(getattr(self, option))) else: # Convert boolean options to integer representation in config string if type(getattr(televend_vmc_config, option)) == bool: options_for_config_string.append(str(int(getattr(televend_vmc_config, option)))) else: options_for_config_string.append(str(getattr(televend_vmc_config, option)))
return '_'.join([self.external_id_ascii_percent] + options_for_config_string)
def _get_machine_related_object_mapping(self): """ Returns a dictionary containing mappings of related model fields to Machine model attributes. Keys should be unified, to ease access to related objects. This is done because related object value is checked using getattr, which can not fetch attributes of related objects directly. Returns: Dictionary containing a mapping of related object names and related object access """ machine_object_mapping = {'machine': self, 'owner': self.owner, 'televend_vmc_config': self.televend_vmc_config, 'televend': self.televend, 'owner_access': self.owner.access} return machine_object_mapping
def check_fiscal_parameter_changes(self, fiscal_values): """ Used to check for changes in machine fiscal parameters :param fiscal_values: :return: """ for fiscal_value, machine_value in FiscalChangeTriggers.items(): if getattr(self, machine_value) != fiscal_values[fiscal_value]: return True return False
def check_fiscal_module_c_parameters(self): """ Checks for relevant fiscal values on machine and company setup, when Croatian fiscal module is applied on company level(Fiscalization Module C). Mostly used to check for presence of expected values. Any other necessary checks may be added here. Returns: List of validation errors if any are present, empty list otherwise """ # local import to avoid circulars from administration.fiscal.helpers import get_company_certificate_expiration_date
object_mapping = self._get_machine_related_object_mapping() validation_errors = [] for fiscal_value in FiscalModuleCParameters: model, field = fiscal_value.split('.') value = getattr(object_mapping[model], field) if not value: validation_errors.append(_(FiscalModuleCErrorMapping[fiscal_value]))
certificate_expiration_date = get_company_certificate_expiration_date( user=None, company_id=self.owner.id, country_code=self.owner.country_code.code )
if not certificate_expiration_date: validation_errors.append(_(FiscalEnumMessage.COMPANY_CERTIFICATE_MISSING.value)) elif certificate_expiration_date < date.today(): validation_errors.append(_(FiscalEnumMessage.COMPANY_CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID.value))
if not self.owner.get_default_tax_rate(): validation_errors.append(_(FiscalEnumMessage.COMPANY_NO_DEFAULT_TAX_RATE.value))
return validation_errors

def custom_planogram_application(self, planogram, custom_options, skip_tags=False): """Enables planogram application in a custom way, depending what user wants to apply. Custom options are:
Column capacity (`max_quantity`): - if ON (checked on FE), apply `max_quantity` value from the planogram on the machine column - if OFF (unchecked on FE), keep existing `max_quantity` value on the machine column and apply everything else, if previous column exists - if new column is added, ON and OFF values does not matter, value from the planogram will be applied to new column - SPECIAL CASE (composite products): - Machine.max_quantity is set to default value 0 - MachineProductComponent.max_quantity is applied from planogram if ON or new column - MachineProductComponent.max_quantity is applied from previous column if OFF and previous column exists
Column filling quantity (`next_fill_quantity`): - if ON (checked on FE), apply `next_fill_quantity` value from the planogram on the machine column, or on the machine product component if product is composite - if OFF (unchecked on FE), keep existing `next_fill_quantity` value on the machine column or machine product component if the product is composite and apply everything else - if new column or product component is added, ON and OFF values does not matter, value from the planogram will be applied to new column - SPECIAL CASE (composite products): - Machine.next_fill_quantity is set to default value None - MachineProductComponent.next_fill_quantity is applied from planogram if ON or new column - MachineProductComponent.next_fill_quantity is applied from previous column if OFF and previous column exists
Product prices (`price, [price_2, price_3, price_4, price_5]`, depending on pricelist count): - if ON (checked on FE), apply prices defined on the planogram to the machine column - if OFF (unchecked on FE), keep existing prices and apply everything else - if new column is added, ON and OFF values does not matter, price from the planogram will be applied to new column
Customized component quantities (_recipe, MachineRecipe queryset) - if ON (checked on FE), apply recipes from the planogram if product on the machine column is same as product in the planogram - if OFF (unchecked on FE), keep existing recipes on the machine column if product on the machine column is same as product in the planogram - if new column is added, ON and OFF values does not matter, value from the planogram will be applied to new column """ apply_capacity = custom_options.get('column_max_quantity') apply_fill_quantity = custom_options.get('column_next_fill_quantity') apply_pickup = custom_options.get('column_minimum_route_pickup') apply_prices = custom_options.get('column_prices') apply_recipes = custom_options.get('column_custom_recipes') reset_product_stock = custom_options.get('column_current_quantity')
def set_column_prices(column, layout_column, pricelist_count, machine_pricelist=None): """ Sets prices for all columns in one go, formatting them before applying. Args: column (obj): Machine column that will be created. layout_column (obj): Template column in planogram. """ fields = ['price', 'price_2', 'price_3', 'price_4', 'price_5'] for field in fields[:pricelist_count]: # change only prices in pricelist price = getattr(layout_column, field) if price is not None and not isinstance(price, Decimal): try: price = Decimal(str(price).replace(',', '.')) except Exception: price = 0.0 if column.id: # existing column and product if price != getattr(column, field): attribute = 'changed_{}'.format(field) setattr(column, attribute, price) else: # new column or existing column but new product if price >= 0: setattr(column, field, price)
for field in fields[pricelist_count:]: # other prices set to column.price if column.id: attribute = 'changed_{}'.format(field) # if we reduce pricelist_count, but we have column.price == layout_column.price # change prices on other price fields if pricelist_count != machine_pricelist: changed_price = column.changed_price if column.changed_price is not None else column.price setattr(column, attribute, changed_price) elif column.changed_price is not None: # make sure we have correct data in price_3, price_4, price_5 setattr(column, attribute, column.changed_price) else: setattr(column, field, column.price)
existing_columns = MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(machine=self, pushed=True) existing_columns_dict = {item.view_index: item for item in existing_columns}
existing_components = MachineProductComponent.all_objects.filter(machine=self, pushed=True) existing_components_dict = {item.component_id: item for item in existing_components}
deleted_columns = [ DeletedColumns(machine_id=item.machine_id, index=item.index) for item in existing_columns ] DeletedColumns.objects.bulk_create(deleted_columns) existing_columns.delete() # delete all machine columns because NEW columns will be created # from the planogram existing_components.delete() # delete all machine components because new components will # be created alongside new columns. MachineColumn.save() method has override to check if # the product on new column is composite and if it is, new components are created too.
template_indexes = [] for layout_column in planogram.get_columns(): template_indexes.append(layout_column.index) original_column = existing_columns_dict.get(layout_column.index) try: original_column, pending_column = self.get_pending_column_change(layout_column.index) if pending_column: pending_column.delete() except Exception: # get_pending_column_change() method raises Exception pass
new_product = layout_column.product if layout_column.product else layout_column.product_rotation_group.active_product if original_column: # machine column on index (layout_column.index) exists if ((layout_column.recipe is None or layout_column.recipe == original_column._recipe) and (new_product is None or new_product == original_column.product) and (layout_column.combo_recipe is None or layout_column.combo_recipe == original_column.combo_recipe) and (layout_column.product_rotation_group == original_column.product_rotation_group)): # product in original column and in planogram are the same original_column.pushed = True original_column.alive = True
if apply_capacity: original_column.set_int('max_quantity', layout_column.max_quantity)
if apply_fill_quantity: original_column.set_int('next_fill_quantity', layout_column.next_fill_quantity)
if apply_pickup: original_column.set_int('minimum_route_pickup', layout_column.minimum_route_pickup)
if original_column.product and original_column.product.is_composite: original_column.set_int('max_quantity', 0) original_column.set_int('next_fill_quantity', None)
# adjust max_quantity after partial planogram update because it is possible to # set lower max_quantity than fill_quantity and that should not be possible! if original_column.max_quantity < original_column.next_fill_quantity: if apply_fill_quantity: original_column.max_quantity = original_column.next_fill_quantity else: original_column.next_fill_quantity = original_column.max_quantity
# Same as above applies for pickup quantity. if original_column.max_quantity < original_column.minimum_route_pickup: if apply_pickup: original_column.max_quantity = original_column.minimum_route_pickup else: original_column.minimum_route_pickup = original_column.max_quantity
if original_column.next_fill_quantity < original_column.minimum_route_pickup: if apply_pickup: original_column.next_fill_quantity = original_column.minimum_route_pickup else: original_column.minimum_route_pickup = original_column.next_fill_quantity
machine = self if apply_prices: set_column_prices(original_column, layout_column, planogram.pricelist_count, machine.pricelist_count) original_column.is_custom_price = original_column.price != new_product.price
original_column.exterminate_nulls()
if apply_recipes: MachineRecipe.objects.filter(column=original_column).delete() if hasattr(original_column, 'recipe_cached'): delattr(original_column, 'recipe_cached')
original_column.set_bool('notify_warning', layout_column.notify_warning) if original_column.notify_warning and (apply_capacity or apply_fill_quantity): original_column.set_int('warning_quantity', layout_column.warning_quantity) original_column.tags_list = layout_column.tags_list or [] original_column.save(planogram=True) else: # new product added on existing column new_column = MachineColumn(machine=self) new_column.index = original_column.index new_column.view_index = layout_column.index new_column._recipe = layout_column.recipe new_column.combo_recipe_id = layout_column.combo_recipe_id new_column.product = new_product new_column.product_rotation_group = layout_column.product_rotation_group
if apply_capacity: max_quantity = layout_column.max_quantity else: max_quantity = original_column.max_quantity
if apply_fill_quantity: next_fill_quantity = layout_column.next_fill_quantity else: next_fill_quantity = original_column.next_fill_quantity
if apply_pickup: minimum_route_pickup = layout_column.minimum_route_pickup else: minimum_route_pickup = original_column.minimum_route_pickup
# adjust max_quantity after partial planogram update because it is possible to # set lower max_quantity than fill_quantity and that should not be possible! if max_quantity < next_fill_quantity: if apply_fill_quantity: max_quantity = next_fill_quantity else: next_fill_quantity = max_quantity
if max_quantity < minimum_route_pickup: if apply_pickup: max_quantity = minimum_route_pickup else: minimum_route_pickup = max_quantity
if next_fill_quantity < minimum_route_pickup: if apply_pickup: next_fill_quantity = minimum_route_pickup else: minimum_route_pickup = next_fill_quantity
if new_product.is_composite: # previous checks do not apply if the product is composite, set default values then max_quantity = 0 next_fill_quantity = None new_column.set_int('max_quantity', max_quantity) new_column.set_int('next_fill_quantity', next_fill_quantity) new_column.set_int('minimum_route_pickup', minimum_route_pickup)
if apply_prices: set_column_prices(new_column, layout_column, planogram.pricelist_count) else: new_column.price = original_column.price new_column.price_2 = original_column.price_2 new_column.price_3 = original_column.price_3 new_column.price_4 = original_column.price_4 new_column.price_5 = original_column.price_5
new_column.exterminate_nulls()
if not apply_recipes: custom_recipe = MachineRecipe.objects.filter(column=original_column).first() if custom_recipe: new_custom_recipe = MachineRecipe(recipe=custom_recipe, column=new_column) new_custom_recipe.save() setattr(new_column, 'recipe_cached', new_custom_recipe)
if not reset_product_stock: if new_column.max_quantity < original_column.current_quantity: new_column.current_quantity = new_column.max_quantity else: new_column.current_quantity = original_column.current_quantity
if layout_column.notify_warning: new_column.set_bool('notify_warning', layout_column.notify_warning) new_column.set_int('warning_quantity', layout_column.warning_quantity)
if layout_column.tags_list: new_column.tags_list = layout_column.tags_list
new_column.save(planogram=True) else: # new product added on new column, custom options do not matter new_column, pending_tags = MachineColumn.create_from_layout(layout_column, self.id, skip_tags=skip_tags) if not apply_prices: if self.pricelist_count > planogram.pricelist_count: set_column_prices(new_column, layout_column, planogram.pricelist_count) else: set_column_prices(new_column, layout_column, self.pricelist_count) else: set_column_prices(new_column, layout_column, planogram.pricelist_count)
if new_column.max_quantity < new_column.next_fill_quantity: if apply_fill_quantity: new_column.max_quantity = new_column.next_fill_quantity else: new_column.next_fill_quantity = new_column.max_quantity
if new_column.max_quantity < new_column.minimum_route_pickup: if apply_fill_quantity: new_column.minimum_route_pickup = new_column.next_fill_quantity else: new_column.next_fill_quantity = new_column.minimum_route_pickup
new_column.set_int('minimum_route_pickup', new_column.minimum_route_pickup) new_column.exterminate_nulls() if pending_tags: new_column.tags_list = pending_tags new_column.save(planogram=True)
if self.use_column_mapping: max_mapping = MachineColumn.objects.filter(machine=self) max_mapping = max_mapping.aggregate(max_index=Max('index'))['max_index'] + 1 for new_column in self.pending_columns_at_new_indexes(): new_column.index = max_mapping new_column.save() max_mapping += 1
if self.offset_mapping != 0: MachineColumn.all_objects.filter(machine=self).update( index=F('view_index') + self.offset_mapping )
# delete pending columns that do not exist in the new template MachineColumn.objects.filter(machine=self, pushed=False).exclude(view_index__in=template_indexes).delete()
# handle change in components layout_components_dict = {item.component_id: item for item in planogram.layoutcomponent_set.all()} for item in self.machineproductcomponent_set.all(): layout_component = layout_components_dict.get(item.component_id) if layout_component: original_component = existing_components_dict.get(item.component_id) item.max_quantity = layout_component.max_quantity item.next_fill_quantity = layout_component.next_fill_quantity item.warning_quantity = layout_component.warning_quantity item.notify_warning = layout_component.notify_warning
if original_component and not apply_capacity: item.max_quantity = original_component.max_quantity
if original_component and not apply_fill_quantity: item.next_fill_quantity = original_component.next_fill_quantity
if original_component and not (apply_capacity or apply_fill_quantity): item.warning_quantity = original_component.warning_quantity
# adjust max_quantity after partial planogram update because it is possible to # set lower max_quantity than fill_quantity and that should not be possible! if item.max_quantity < item.next_fill_quantity: if apply_fill_quantity: item.max_quantity = item.next_fill_quantity else: item.next_fill_quantity = item.max_quantity if layout_component.tags: if item.tags_list is None: item.tags_list = layout_component.tags else: item.tags_list.extend(layout_component.tags)
item.save()

def pending_columns_at_new_indexes(self): """ :return: Pending columns at previously not existing indexes. """ # exclude pending remove columns pending_remove_indexes = MachineColumn.all_objects.filter( machine=self, alive=False, pushed=True ).values_list('view_index', flat=True) # return machine columns which are pending add, not pending replace return self.machinecolumn_set.filter(pushed=False).exclude(view_index__in=pending_remove_indexes)
def get_pending_column_change(self, view_index):
"""Return original and pending :class:`~MachineColumn`.
If there is a pending column change, return 2-tuple (original, pending) Otherwise return (None, None)"""
columns = MachineColumn.all_objects.select_related('machine__status').filter( Q(machine=self), Q(view_index=view_index), # one column must be not alive and pushed (Q(pushed=True) & Q(alive=False)) | (Q(pushed=False) & Q(alive=True))) columns = columns.order_by('-id')[0:2]
# wrong number of arguments means no pending change if len(columns) == 1: pending = columns[0] # additional simple integrity checks if pending.pushed or not pending.alive: raise Exception('Inconsistent data. Single column instance') return None, pending
elif len(columns) == 2: pending, original = columns
# additional simple integrity checks if (original.pushed or not original.alive or pending.pushed or not pending.alive) and False: raise Exception('Inconsistent data. Two column instances.') return original, pending return None, None
def get_alternate_column(self, view_index): """Return :class:`~MachineColumn` object to be used as default.""" column = MachineColumn(machine=self, view_index=view_index, pushed=False) return column
@classmethod def _get_category_urgency_query(cls, last_month, company_id):
sales_per_cat = "select Count(v.id) as sales, p.category_id as category, v.machine_id as mid " \ "from vends as v join products as p on p.id = v.product_id " \ "where v.alive = true and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} and v.timestamp > \'{0}\' " \ "group by v.machine_id, p.category_id"
qty_per_cat = "select sum(cast(mc.current_quantity as float)/cast(mc.next_fill_quantity as float))" \ "/cast(count(*) as float) as fill_percentage, " \ "mc.machine_id as mid, p.category_id as category " \ "from machine_columns as mc join products as p on p.id = mc.product_id " \ "where mc.pushed = true and mc.next_fill_quantity > 0 " \ "and p.is_composite = false and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} " \ "group by mc.machine_id, p.category_id"
price_per_cat = "select Avg(p.price/(1+(t.value/100.))) as price, p.category_id as category " \ "from products as p join tax_rates as t on p.tax_rate_id = t.id " \ "where p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} " \ "group by p.category_id"
query = "select s1.category, s1.mid, (cast(s1.sales as float) / 30.)*s3.price as importance, s2.fill_percentage from " \ "(" + sales_per_cat + ") as s1 join (" + qty_per_cat + ") as s2 on s1.category = s2.category and s1.mid = s2.mid" \ " join (" + price_per_cat + ") as s3 on s3.category = s1.category;"
query = query.format(last_month, company_id)
return query
@classmethod def _get_product_urgency_query(cls, last_month, company_id):
sales_per_cat = "select Count(v.id) as sales, p.id as product, v.machine_id as mid " \ "from vends as v join products as p on p.id = v.product_id " \ "where v.alive = true and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} and v.timestamp > \'{0}\' " \ "group by v.machine_id, p.id"
qty_per_cat = "select sum(cast(mc.current_quantity as float)/cast(mc.next_fill_quantity as float))" \ "/cast(count(*) as float) as fill_percentage, " \ "mc.machine_id as mid, p.id as product " \ "from machine_columns as mc join products as p on p.id = mc.product_id " \ "where mc.pushed = true and mc.next_fill_quantity > 0 " \ "and p.is_composite = false and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} " \ "group by mc.machine_id, p.id"
price_per_cat = "select p.price/(1+(t.value/100.)) as price, p.id as product " \ "from products as p join tax_rates as t on p.tax_rate_id = t.id " \ "where p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} "
query = "select s1.product as category, s1.mid, (cast(s1.sales as float) / 30.)*s3.price as importance, s2.fill_percentage from " \ "(" + sales_per_cat + ") as s1 join (" + qty_per_cat + ") as s2 on s1.product = s2.product and s1.mid = s2.mid" \ " join (" + price_per_cat + ") as s3 on s3.product = s1.product;"
query = query.format(last_month, company_id)
return query
@classmethod def _get_days_until_dead_query(cls, last_month, company_id):
sales_per_cat = "select (cast(Count(v.id) as float) / 30.) as avg_sales_per_day, p.id as product, v.machine_id as mid " \ "from vends as v join products as p on p.id = v.product_id " \ "where v.alive = true and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} and v.timestamp > \'{0}\' " \ "group by v.machine_id, p.id"
qty_per_cat = "select sum(cast(mc.current_quantity as float)/cast(mc.next_fill_quantity as float))" \ "/cast(count(*) as float) as fill_percentage, sum(cast(mc.current_quantity as float))" \ " as capacity_left, sum(cast(mc.next_fill_quantity as float)) as max_capacity, mc.machine_id as mid, p.id as product " \ "from machine_columns as mc join products as p on p.id = mc.product_id " \ "where mc.pushed = true and mc.next_fill_quantity > 0 " \ "and p.is_composite = false and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} " \ "group by mc.machine_id, p.id"
price_per_cat = "select p.price/(1+(t.value/100.)) as price, p.id as product " \ "from products as p join tax_rates as t on p.tax_rate_id = t.id " \ "where p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} "
query = "select s1.product as category, s1.mid, s1.avg_sales_per_day*s3.price as importance," \ " s2.fill_percentage, (s2.capacity_left / s1.avg_sales_per_day) as days_left, (s2.max_capacity / s1.avg_sales_per_day) as avg_cycle from " \ "(" + sales_per_cat + ") as s1 join (" + qty_per_cat + ") as s2 on s1.product = s2.product and s1.mid = s2.mid" \ " join (" + price_per_cat + ") as s3 on s3.product = s1.product;"
query = query.format(last_month, company_id)
return query
@classmethod def _get_loss_by_day_query(cls, last_month, company_id):
empty_facings = "select machine_id as mid, product_id as product from machine_columns as mc " \ "where pushed=true and next_fill_quantity > 0" \ " and machine_id in (select id from machines where owner_id = {1})" \ " group by machine_id, product_id having sum(mc.current_quantity) = 0"
price_per_product = "select p.price/(1+(t.value/100.)) as price, p.id as product " \ "from products as p join tax_rates as t on p.tax_rate_id = t.id " \ "where p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} "
sales_per_product = "select (cast(Count(v.id) as float) / 30.) as avg_sales_per_day, " \ "p.id as product, v.machine_id as mid " \ "from vends as v join products as p on p.id = v.product_id " \ "where v.alive = true and p.alive = true and p.owner_id = {1} and v.timestamp > \'{0}\' " \ "group by v.machine_id, p.id"
query = "select sum(s1.avg_sales_per_day*s3.price) as daily_loss, s1.mid as machine from " \ "(" + sales_per_product + ") as s1 join (" + empty_facings + ") as s2 on s1.product = s2.product " \ "and s1.mid = s2.mid join (" + price_per_product + ") as s3 on s3.product = s1.product group by s1.mid;"
query = query.format(last_month, company_id)
return query
@classmethod def get_machine_urgencies(cls, company_id, machines_list=None, superadmin=False, type=1): cache_key = "administration.models.get_machine_urgencies.{}.{}" cache_key = cache_key.format(type, company_id) data = cache.get(cache_key) if not data: last_month = (get_current_datetime_utc() - timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
cursor = connection.cursor()
if type == 1: cursor.execute(cls._get_category_urgency_query(last_month, company_id)) elif type == 2: cursor.execute(cls._get_product_urgency_query(last_month, company_id))
desc = cursor.description
data = [ dict(zip([col[0] for col in desc], row)) for row in cursor.fetchall() ] cache.set(cache_key, data, 900)
mids = cls.objects.filter(owner_id=company_id).values_list('id', flat=True)
machines = {}
if machines_list is None: for mid in mids: up = sum( [d['importance'] * (1 - (d['fill_percentage'] if d['fill_percentage'] > 0 else -0.5)) for d in data if d['mid'] == mid]) down = sum([d['importance'] for d in data if d['mid'] == mid]) if down: machines[mid] = up / down else: machines[mid] = None
return machines
else: for m in machines_list: up = sum( [d['importance'] * (1 - (d['fill_percentage'] if d['fill_percentage'] > 0 else -0.5)) for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id]) down = sum([d['importance'] for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id]) if superadmin: m.importance = {d['category']: d['importance'] for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id} if down: if type == 2: m.p_urgency = up / down else: m.urgency = up / down else: if type == 2: m.p_urgency = None else: m.urgency = None
return machines_list
@classmethod def get_machine_critical_days(cls, company_id, machines_list=None): if machines_list is None: return None
last_month = (get_current_datetime_utc() - timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
cursor = connection.cursor()
cursor.execute(cls._get_days_until_dead_query(last_month, company_id))
desc = cursor.description data = [ dict(zip([col[0] for col in desc], row)) for row in cursor.fetchall() ]
for m in machines_list: up = sum([d['importance'] * d['days_left'] for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id]) down = sum([d['importance'] for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id]) if down: tmp = up / down for i in range(int(tmp)): if not m.location.weekday_mask[(get_current_datetime_utc().weekday() + i) % 7]: tmp += 1 m.days_until_dead = tmp else: m.days_until_dead = None
cycles = sorted([{'importance': d['importance'], 'avg_cycle': d['avg_cycle'] } for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id], key=lambda k: k['importance'], reverse=True)
cycles = cycles[:int(len(cycles) * 0.2)] down = sum([c['importance'] for c in cycles])
if down: tmp = sum([c['avg_cycle'] * c['importance'] for c in cycles]) / down m.average_cycle = tmp else: m.average_cycle = None
return machines_list
@classmethod def get_machine_average_cycle(cls, company_id, machines_list=None): if machines_list is None: return None
last_month = (get_current_datetime_utc() - timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
cursor = connection.cursor()
cursor.execute(cls._get_days_until_dead_query(last_month, company_id))
desc = cursor.description data = [ dict(zip([col[0] for col in desc], row)) for row in cursor.fetchall() ]
for m in machines_list: cycles = sorted([{'importance': d['importance'], 'avg_cycle': d['avg_cycle'] } for d in data if d['mid'] == m.id], key=lambda k: k['importance'], reverse=True)
cycles_2 = cycles[:max(int(len(cycles) * 0.1), 1)] cycles = cycles[:max(int(len(cycles) * 0.2), 1)]
down = sum([c['importance'] for c in cycles])
if down: tmp = sum([c['avg_cycle'] * c['importance'] for c in cycles]) / down m.average_cycle = tmp else: m.average_cycle = None
down = sum([c['importance'] for c in cycles_2])
if down: tmp = sum([c['avg_cycle'] * c['importance'] for c in cycles_2]) / down m.average_cycle_10 = tmp else: m.average_cycle_10 = None
return machines_list
@classmethod def get_machine_daily_loss(cls, company_id, machines_list=None): if machines_list is None: return None
last_month = (get_current_datetime_utc() - timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
